title: WA HUSSAINA WA HUSSAINA
body:
wa hussaina wa hussaina
wa hussaina wa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi ghurbat bhi kahi'n hai
sar pa ab koi nahi hai
ye yateemo'n ki sada hai
<<MINI>>
wa hussaina wa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi aafat ki ghadi hai
sar ko maa peet rahi hai
fatima ki ye sada hai
<<MINI>>
wa hussaina wa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala me hai qayamat
kaisi hai dhoop ki shiddat
jalti ab karbobala hai
<<MINI>>
wa hussaina wa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
humko ghazi ki qasam hai
humko sarwar ki qasam hai
kehta har ahle aza hai
<<MINI>>
wa hussaina wa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane hyder teri jaa'n hai
ashk aankhon se rawa'n hai
sunke dil kaanp gaya hai
<<MINI>>
wa hussaina wa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
bus ye zehra ka karam hai
sar pe saqqa e haram hai
nouha dawar ne likha hai
<<MINI>>
wa hussaina wa hussaina
